title: Chip and Dip, Midnight

images.caption: Great for chips and dips, sushi, or even your favorite fruit with yogurt! Customizeable

description:
The same chip and dip form in a glossy near-black glaze that clouds to smoky blue across the centre. The dip bowl rises out of the rim in a single curl.

The shape and the glazes can be customized
alt: A glossy black and smoky blue chip and dip platter with the dip bowl rising from the rim
